findings.suggested_fix: Extend the existing keyboard counterpart test to assert aria-pressed=true immediately after selecting a source/output, false after matching and Escape, and the mapping live-region messages after selection, matching, cancellation and pair reorder. Add a select-again case proving same-card cancellation; verify opposite-kind cards expose the intended valid-target state.
findings.title: Assert active selection and accessible action announcements
findings.why_it_matters: The keyboard acceptance test would still pass if every card permanently exposed aria-pressed=false and the matching live region never announced an action. A screen-reader user would then lose confirmation of which card is selected, whether Escape cancelled it, and whether a match or reorder succeeded. The plan explicitly requires selected/target states and focus/status verification; extend this existing interaction test so those regressions fail.

residual_risks: Firefox and WebKit configured production suites could not run because executables were missing and downloads were denied. Chromium checks do not establish native bidirectional drag, modal focus, accessibility, privacy/CSP or export behavior in those browsers. Hands-on U2 acceptance remains pending.

Performance qualification remains unresolved: both the warm 10,000-row/20-column 5-second budget and initial 499-row/20-column 1-second budget failed during caller rechecks. All six trials passed downloaded-data assertions before timing assertions failed. The review does not establish a new implementation regression or passing performance budgets.
testing_gaps: tests/e2e/privacy.spec.ts:66 replaces the prior sentinel-bearing output-header rename with Notes. Restore a distinct private sentinel in the renamed destination header and include it in request/diagnostic checks so user-entered output names remain covered.

tests/e2e/row-mapping.spec.ts:79-102 exercises upward keyboard/grip pair reorder, then restores the original order before downloading. Add downward keyboard/grip reorder and assert preview/export data while the schema remains C,Gap,A to cover the new downward branch and preserved source associations.
